core_idea: Seven Assoc. South Section 6 Ryōshū is a Status Specialist — **Fragile** setup — apply Fragile or typed Fragility debuffs so the team deals amplified skill damage on the following turn.
playstyle_guide:
- Apply Fragile or typed Fragility on the setup turn; coordinate team burst on the next turn.

**S1 — Slash** (BP 4, CP +8, 1 coin): rolls — low 4, high 12 (High).

**S2 — Upper Slash** (BP 4, CP +14, 1 coin): rolls — low 4, high 18 (Extremely High).
- Skill Power +2 against units that have Slash Fragility ; [Clash Win] Gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn
- Skill Power +2 against units that have Slash Fragility; [Clash Win] Gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn

**S3 — Swash** (BP 4, CP +5, 3 coins): rolls — low 4, high 19 (High).

Combat passive — **C.I.H.**: Deal +10% Slash damage this turn.

Combat passive — **Ice Breaker**: 1 ally that has the lowest Max HP inflicts +1 Rupture.
team_suggestions: Flexible pick; slotting alongside identities whose support passives provide relevant statuses or SP recovery maximises uptime.
- Pair with identities whose support passives inflict statuses this kit stacks or scales off.
